finding: HeapCreate failure fell back to shared game process heap while retaining HEAP_NO_SERIALIZE. The Rust-only guard did not serialize native game callers, allowing heap corruption.
change: No process-heap fallback; return allocation failure or an already-published private race winner. Guard null handles before alloc/realloc; deallocation uses existing owning handle.
independent_review: /root/army_units confirmed the hazard and reviewed root fix without findings.
tests: New injected private-creation failure across normal/overaligned and zeroed paths, plus failed creator seeing genuine private winner. Windows/Wine execution and existing cross-thread-free regression pending broker release.
performance_claim: None. This is a correctness fix on exceptional allocation path, not proof of steady-frame speedup.
